mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, email, phone, is_admin, status, created_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{isAdmin}, COALESCE(#{status}, 0), NOW())
INSERT INTO user_collection (user_id, novel_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{novelId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE created_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_collection WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND novel_id = #{novelId}
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.book_main_name, n.author, n.label, n.cover, n.read_count, c.created_at FROM user_collection c JOIN novel_book_main n ON c.novel_id = n.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
